# Getting started

The Octopart API is a GraphQL API for electronic component supply data. This page gets you from an access token to a first successful query. Creating an application, getting a client ID and secret and exchanging them for a token are covered in the [Altium Developer Center](https://www.altium.com/documentation/altium-developer-center/quick-starts/octopart-api).

## Endpoint

All operations go to one endpoint:

```text
https://api.nexar.com/graphql
```

## Authentication

Every request carries an access token in the `Authorization` header:

```text
Authorization: Bearer {access-token}
```

Tokens come from the OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant. See [Authorization](https://www.altium.com/documentation/altium-developer-center/octopart/api/authorization) in the Developer Center for the token request, token lifetime and renewal.

## A first query

Search parts by manufacturer part number and read the manufacturer, the Octopart page and the number of hits:

```graphql
query FirstSearch {
  supSearchMpn(q: "LM358", limit: 3) {
    hits
    results {
      part {
        mpn
        manufacturer {
          name
        }
        shortDescription
        octopartUrl
      }
    }
  }
}
```

With `curl`:

```bash
curl https://api.nexar.com/graphql \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OCTOPART_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"query FirstSearch { supSearchMpn(q: \"LM358\", limit: 3) { hits results { part { mpn manufacturer { name } shortDescription octopartUrl } } } }"}'
```

The response is a JSON object with a `data` member (and an `errors` member if something went wrong, see [Errors](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/guides/errors.md)). Reference: [`supSearchMpn`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-search-mpn.md).

Prices and stock are returned for a country and a currency: `supSearch`, `supSearchMpn`, `supParts` and `supMultiMatch` take `country` and `currency` arguments, which default to `"US"` and `"USD"`.

Some fields need a higher plan; their descriptions say so. See [Plans and limits](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/guides/plans-and-limits.md).

## Tools

- **Nitro**: an in-browser GraphQL IDE with schema-aware completion, at `https://api.nexar.com/graphql`.
- **Voyager**: an interactive graph of the schema, at `https://api.nexar.com/ui/voyager`.

## Next steps

- [Bounded contexts](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/guides/bounded-contexts.md): find the part of the API that owns your data.
- [Naming conventions](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/guides/naming-conventions.md), [Pagination](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/guides/pagination.md), [Errors](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/guides/errors.md) and [Plans and limits](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/guides/plans-and-limits.md).
- The [Developer Center example queries](https://www.altium.com/documentation/altium-developer-center/octopart/api/example-queries).

## For AI assistants

Point your coding assistant at [llms.txt](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/llms.txt). It lists every bounded context with its own `llms.txt` index and a compact `schema.graphql` slice, and every page of this site is also available as Markdown (append `.md` to the page URL).

# Bounded contexts

The reference is grouped by **bounded context**: a business area with its own entities and vocabulary. Each context lists its queries, mutations and types. A type that is used in one context but defined in another shows the defining context as a badge.

| Context | What it owns | Example entry points |
| - | - | - |
| [Supply](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/overview.md) | Parts, offers, sellers, manufacturers, categories, attributes, part search and matching | `supSearch`, `supSearchMpn`, `supParts`, `supMultiMatch` |
| [Part Family](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/overview.md) | Part families and part groups, their parameters, and search | `supPartFamilySearch`, `supPartGroupById` |
| [Reference Design](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/overview.md) | Reference designs, their files, parts and resources | `supRefDesigns`, `supRefDesignById` |
| [Solution Template](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/overview.md) | Solution templates and their applications, parameters, compatible evaluation kits and reference designs | `supSolutionTemplateSearch`, `supSolutionTemplateById` |
| [Eval Kit](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/overview.md) | Evaluation kits, their devices, parameters and preview images, and the reference designs and software projects they are compatible with | `supEvalKitSearch`, `supEvalKitById` |
| [Supply Software Project](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/overview.md) | Software projects and their compatibility with evaluation kits and solution templates | `supSoftwareProjectSearch`, `supSoftwareProjectById` |
| [Procurement](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/procurement/overview.md) | Bill of materials analysis built on supply data | `datBomParts`, `datBomAnalyses` |

[Common](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/overview.md) holds the scalars, paging and error types that every context uses.

A single request can combine contexts. This one matches a BOM line to Octopart parts (Procurement) and reads each match from Supply:

```graphql
query MatchBomLine {
  datBomParts(items: [{ itemRefId: "R1", mpn: "RC0603FR-0710KL", manufacturerName: "Yageo" }]) {
    itemRefId
    parts {
      confidence
      part {
        mpn
        manufacturer {
          name
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## What is not on this site

The endpoint serves more than these seven contexts. Operations that are not documented here are not part of the Octopart API as described on this site:

- Design data (`des…` operations) is documented in the [Altium 365 API reference](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/).
- Other domains served by the same gateway are outside the scope of this reference.

The downloadable [schema.graphql](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/schema.graphql) contains the documented scope only.

# Naming conventions

Names in the Octopart API follow a few patterns. Once you know them, the operation you need is usually easy to guess.

## Prefixes

Every operation and type name starts with the domain that owns it, then the area within that domain:

| Prefix | Domain | Examples |
| - | - | - |
| `sup` / `Sup` | Supply data | `supSearch`, `SupPart`, `SupOffer` |
| `supPartFamily`, `supPartGroup` | Part families | `supPartFamilySearch`, `SupPartGroup` |
| `supRef` | Reference designs | `supRefDesignById`, `SupRefDesign` |
| `supSolutionTemplate` | Solution templates | `supSolutionTemplateById`, `SupSolutionTemplate` |
| `supEvalKit` | Evaluation kits | `supEvalKitById`, `SupEvalKit` |
| `supSoftwareProject` | Software projects | `supSoftwareProjectById`, `SupSoftwareProject` |
| `datBom` / `DatBom` | Procurement: BOM analysis | `datBomParts`, `DatBomPart` |

Search on this site ignores the prefixes: typing `part family` finds `SupPartFamily`.

## Queries

| Pattern | Returns | Example |
| - | - | - |
| `…ById(id:)` | One item, or `null` | `supRefDesignById`, `supSolutionTemplateById` |
| `…ByIds(ids:)` | A list | `supSolutionTemplatesByIds`, `supSoftwareProjectsByIds` |
| `…ByName(name:)` | One item | `supRefDesignByName`, `supPartGroupByName` |
| `…Search` | A result set or a connection | `supPartFamilySearch`, `supSolutionTemplateSearch` |

For parts, `supParts(ids:)` looks up by Octopart part id, and `supSearchMpn` and `supMultiMatch` look up by manufacturer part number:

```graphql
query PartsByIdAndMpn {
  supParts(ids: ["39619421"]) {
    id
    mpn
  }
  supMultiMatch(queries: [{ mpn: "LM358", start: 0, limit: 1 }]) {
    hits
    parts {
      id
      mpn
    }
  }
}
```

## Mutations

Mutations take a single `input` argument of type `…Input!` and return a `…Payload!`:

```graphql
type Mutation {
  supSolutionTemplateSetTags(input: SupSolutionTemplateSetTagsInput!): SupSolutionTemplateSetTagsPayload!
}
```

Collections of a solution template, an evaluation kit or a software project have two mutations:

- **Set** replaces the whole collection: `supSolutionTemplateSetTags` takes the full `tags` list.
- **Patch** adds and removes items: `supSolutionTemplatePatchTags` takes `addTags` and `removeTags`.

Payloads carry an `errors` list typed as a union of the errors that the mutation can return. See [Errors](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/guides/errors.md).

# Pagination

Lists in the Octopart API are paged in one of two ways. The arguments of an operation tell you which one it uses.

## Offset paging

Part search, part family search and reference design search take `start` (the offset of the first result) and `limit` (the page size), and return the total number of matches in `hits`:

```graphql
query SecondPage {
  supSearch(q: "buck converter", start: 10, limit: 10) {
    hits
    results {
      part {
        mpn
        manufacturer {
          name
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Request the next page by adding `limit` to `start` until `start` reaches `hits`.

Operations that page this way include [`supSearch`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-search.md), [`supSearchMpn`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-search-mpn.md), [`supPartFamilySearch`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/operations/queries/sup-part-family-search.md), [`supRefDesigns`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/operations/queries/sup-ref-designs.md), [`supSolutionTemplates`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/operations/queries/sup-solution-templates.md), [`supEvalKits`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/operations/queries/sup-eval-kits.md) and [`supSoftwareProjects`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-projects.md).

## Cursor paging

The `…Search` operations of solution templates, evaluation kits and software projects return [Relay connections](https://relay.dev/graphql/connections.htm). They take `first` and `after` (or `last` and `before`), and return `nodes` (or `edges`), `pageInfo` and `totalCount`:

```graphql
query SolutionTemplates($after: String) {
  supSolutionTemplateSearch(first: 20, after: $after) {
    totalCount
    nodes {
      id
      title
    }
    pageInfo {
      hasNextPage
      endCursor
    }
  }
}
```

Pass `pageInfo.endCursor` as `after` to get the next page while `pageInfo.hasNextPage` is `true`.

Operations that page this way: [`supSolutionTemplateSearch`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/operations/queries/sup-solution-template-search.md), [`supSolutionTemplateApplicationsSearch`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/operations/queries/sup-solution-template-applications-search.md), [`supEvalKitSearch`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/operations/queries/sup-eval-kit-search.md), [`supSoftwareProjectSearch`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-project-search.md) and [`supSoftwareProjectEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectSearch`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-project-eval-kit-compatible-software-project-search.md).

The Developer Center has more on [paging through search results](https://www.altium.com/documentation/altium-developer-center/octopart/api/pagination).

# Errors

The API reports errors in the standard GraphQL way, and mutations also return typed errors in their payloads.

## The errors array

The result of an operation is returned in `data`. If something goes wrong, the response also has a top-level `errors` array next to `data`; `errors` is present only when there is at least one error. A response can contain both: the fields that could be resolved are returned in `data`, and the ones that failed are `null` and described in `errors`, each with a `message` and the `path` of the failed field.

## Mutation payload errors

Mutations of solution templates, evaluation kits and software projects return a payload with an `errors` list. Its type is a union of the errors that the mutation can produce, so you can select the fields of each one:

```graphql
mutation DeleteTemplate($id: ID!) {
  supSolutionTemplateDeleteSolutionTemplate(input: { id: $id }) {
    errors {
      ... on SupSolutionTemplateNotFoundError {
        message
        errorCode
      }
      ... on SupSolutionTemplateOperationFailedError {
        message
        errorCode
      }
    }
  }
}
```

An empty or missing `errors` list means the mutation succeeded. Every error type implements [`Error`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/interfaces/error.md) and has a `message`. The errors of each domain also have an `errorCode` from that domain's enum, such as [`SupSolutionTemplateErrorCode`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/enums/sup-solution-template-error-code.md).

# Plans and limits

Some fields and arguments are available only on certain plans, and some arguments have limits. The reference shows this in the description of the field or argument, as one or more notes:

| Note | Meaning |
| - | - |
| Requires plan tier: `PRO` | The field needs a plan of at least the named tier. |
| Requires plan feature: `TECH_SPECS` | The field needs a plan that includes the named feature. |
| Constraint: `max=2000` | The argument value must meet the constraint. |

For example, [`SupPart.specs`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part.md) needs the `PRO` tier and the `TECH_SPECS` feature, and the `q` argument of [`supSearch`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-search.md) has the constraint `max=2000`. A query that selects `specs` therefore needs a plan with that tier and feature:

```graphql
query PartSpecs {
  supSearchMpn(q: "LM358", limit: 1) {
    results {
      part {
        mpn
        specs {
          attribute {
            name
          }
          displayValue
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Plans, the features they include and their request limits are described in [Plans and subscriptions](https://www.altium.com/documentation/altium-developer-center/octopart/api/plans-subscriptions) in the Developer Center.

# Supply

Parts, offers, sellers, manufacturers, categories, attributes, part search and part matching.

For AI assistants: [llms.txt](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/llms.txt) · [schema slice](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/schema.graphql) · [all types](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types.txt)

## Entities

API types in this bounded context that represent Common Data Model (CDM) entities. The IRI is the entity's stable identifier in the CDM.

| API type | CDM entity |
| - | - |
| [`SupCompany`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-company.md) | [Company](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/Company) [`https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/Company`](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/Company) |
| [`SupOffer`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-offer.md) | [Offer](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/Offer) [`https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/Offer`](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/Offer) |
| [`SupPart`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part.md) | [Part](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/Part) [`https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/Part`](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/Part) |

## Entry points

Look up entities by identifier:

- [`supCategoriesByIds`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-categories-by-ids.md)
- [`supCategoryById`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-category-by-id.md)

# supCategories

Get categories

### Type

#### [`SupCategory`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-category.md) object

A Category exists in a Category tree. Examples include Passive Components or Capacitors. The `path` field is helpful to see where a category is in the tree.

```graphql
supCategories(
  ids: [String!]
  paths: [String!]
  root: SupCategoryRoot! = ElectronicParts
): [SupCategory!]!
```

### Arguments

#### `ids` · [`[String!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) list scalar

list of category IDs. Omit to fetch all categories. Where id can be either an Octopart internal id or an Altium Global Resource ID (GRID).

#### `paths` · [`[String!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) list scalar

list of SEO page paths for categories to include.

#### `root` · [`SupCategoryRoot!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/enums/sup-category-root.md) non-null enum

Root of categories to include, defaults to ElectronicParts.

# supManufacturers

Get manufacturer companies

### Type

#### [`SupCompany`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-company.md) object

A company record represents a manufacturer or distributor, depending on context.

```graphql
supManufacturers(
  ids: [String!]
  slugs: [String!]
  includeSuspended: Boolean! = false
): [SupCompany!]!
```

### Arguments

#### `ids` · [`[String!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) list scalar

list of company IDs. Omit to fetch all manufacturers.

#### `slugs` · [`[String!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) list scalar

list of URL slugs for /manufacturers paths

#### `includeSuspended` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) non-null scalar

Include temporarily suspended manufacturers in results. Intended for manufacturer taxonomy pages.

# supMultiMatch

Match multiple manufacturer + mpn pairs at once. Useful for when you have a list of parts, as with a BOM (Bill of Materials)

### Type

#### [`SupPartMatch`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part-match.md) object

```graphql
supMultiMatch(
  queries: [SupPartMatchQuery!]!
  options: SupPartMatchOptions
  country: String! = US
  currency: String! = USD
  distributorApi: Boolean
  distributorApiTimeout: String! = 3s
  customPricingCredentials: [SupApiCredentials!]
  rankingMethod: SupSearchRankingMethod! = DEFAULT
): [SupPartMatch!]!
```

### Arguments

#### `queries` · [`[SupPartMatchQuery!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/inputs/sup-part-match-query.md) non-null input

list of inputs to attempt to match

#### `options` · [`SupPartMatchOptions`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/inputs/sup-part-match-options.md) input

options when matching such as applying filters or only including authorized or in-stock parts

#### `country` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

user's country

#### `currency` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

user's currency

#### `distributorApi` · [`Boolean`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) scalar

fetch latest pricing and stock data from distributor API. Company.isDistributorApi indicates if a distributor supports this feature.

#### `distributorApiTimeout` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

how long to wait for distributor API to respond as a duration string (e.g. `3s` or `500ms`)

#### `customPricingCredentials` · [`[SupApiCredentials!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/inputs/sup-api-credentials.md) list input

if needed, pass along credentials for API integrations

Requires plan tier: `ENTERPRISE`.

#### `rankingMethod` · [`SupSearchRankingMethod!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/enums/sup-search-ranking-method.md) non-null enum

Specifying a ranking method.

# supParts

Get parts by ID.

### Type

#### [`SupPart`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part.md) object

Part model contains the relevant data around a part, including: datasheets, specs, sellers + offers, images, etc.

```graphql
supParts(
  ids: [String!]!
  country: String! = US
  currency: String! = USD
  distributorApi: Boolean
  distributorApiTimeout: String! = 3s
  customPricingCredentials: [SupApiCredentials!]
): [SupPart]!
```

### Arguments

#### `ids` · [`[String!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

list of part IDs. APIv3 UIDs are also supported.

#### `country` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

user's country

#### `currency` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

user's currency

#### `distributorApi` · [`Boolean`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) scalar

fetch latest pricing and stock data from distributor API. Company.isDistributorApi indicates if a distributor supports this feature.

#### `distributorApiTimeout` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

how long to wait for distributor API to respond as a duration string (e.g. `3s` or `500ms`) up to a max 10s

#### `customPricingCredentials` · [`[SupApiCredentials!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/inputs/sup-api-credentials.md) list input

if needed, pass along credentials for API integrations

Requires plan tier: `ENTERPRISE`.

# supSearch

Search parts, including filters, pagination, aggregation, sorting

### Type

#### [`SupPartResultSet`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part-result-set.md) object

Result of part search.

```graphql
supSearch(
  q: String
  country: String! = US
  currency: String! = USD
  start: Int
  limit: Int
  sort: String
  sortDir: SupSortDirection
  inStockOnly: Boolean
  filters: Map
  distributorApi: Boolean
  distributorApiTimeout: String! = 3s
  customPricingCredentials: [SupApiCredentials!]
  rankingMethod: SupSearchRankingMethod! = DEFAULT
): SupPartResultSet!
```

### Arguments

#### `q` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

the query to search

Constraint: `max=2000`.

#### `country` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

user's country

#### `currency` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

user's currency

#### `start` · [`Int`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) scalar

offset in the result set

#### `limit` · [`Int`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) scalar

page size of results

#### `sort` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

field to sort by. See [sort values](https://octopart.com/api/v4/values#sort)

#### `sortDir` · [`SupSortDirection`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/enums/sup-sort-direction.md) enum

direction of sort: `asc` or `desc`

#### `inStockOnly` · [`Boolean`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) scalar

filter to remove parts with no stocking distributors

#### `filters` · [`Map`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/map.md) scalar

a key: value map of filters. See [filter values](https://octopart.com/api/v4/values#attributes)

#### `distributorApi` · [`Boolean`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) scalar

fetch latest pricing and stock data from distributor API. Company.isDistributorApi indicates if a distributor supports this feature.

#### `distributorApiTimeout` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

how long to wait for distributor API to respond as a duration string (e.g. `3s` or `500ms`)

#### `customPricingCredentials` · [`[SupApiCredentials!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/inputs/sup-api-credentials.md) list input

if needed, pass along credentials for API integrations

Requires plan tier: `ENTERPRISE`.

#### `rankingMethod` · [`SupSearchRankingMethod!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/enums/sup-search-ranking-method.md) non-null enum

Specifying a ranking method.

# supSearchCorrection

```graphql
): [SupSearchCorrection!]!
```

Fixed filters that should always be applied i.e. don't suggest corrections that would drop these filters.

# supSellers

Get seller companies (distributors)

### Type

#### [`SupCompany`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-company.md) object

A company record represents a manufacturer or distributor, depending on context.

```graphql
supSellers(
  ids: [String!]
  customPricingOnly: Boolean! = false
  includeSuspended: Boolean! = false
  slugs: [String!]
): [SupCompany!]!
```

### Arguments

#### `ids` · [`[String!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) list scalar

list of company IDs. Omit to fetch all sellers.

#### `customPricingOnly` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) non-null scalar

Include only companies that support custom pricing.

#### `includeSuspended` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) non-null scalar

Include temporarily suspended distributors in results. Intended for distributor taxonomy pages.

#### `slugs` · [`[String!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) list scalar

list of URL slugs for /distributors paths

#### [`SupSuggestion`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-suggestion.md) object

```graphql
  q: String!
  categoryId: String
  partNumbersOnly: Boolean
): [SupSuggestion!]!
```

### Arguments

# SupCategory

A Category exists in a Category tree. Examples include Passive Components or Capacitors. The `path` field is helpful to see where a category is in the tree.

### Returned By

[`supCategories`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-categories.md) query · [`supCategoriesByIds`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-categories-by-ids.md) query · [`supCategoryById`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-category-by-id.md) query

### Member Of

[`SupCategory`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-category.md) object · [`SupCategoryBucket`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-category-bucket.md) object · [`SupPart`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part.md) object · [`SupPartFamily`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family.md) object · [`SupPartGroup`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-group.md) object · [`SupPartResultSet`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part-result-set.md) object · [`SupRefApplicationBucket`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/types/objects/sup-ref-application-bucket.md) object · [`SupRefCategoryBucket`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/types/objects/sup-ref-category-bucket.md) object · [`SupRefDesign`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/types/objects/sup-ref-design.md) object · [`SupSolutionTemplate`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/objects/sup-solution-template.md) object · [`SupSolutionTemplateApplication`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/objects/sup-solution-template-application.md) object

```graphql
type SupCategory {
  id: ID!
  parentId: ID!
  name: String!
  ancestors: [SupCategory!]!
  children: [SupCategory!]!
  path: String!
  relevantAttributes: [SupAttribute!]!
  blurb: SupBlurb
  numParts: Int!
}
```

### Fields

#### `id` · [`ID!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/id.md) non-null scalar

#### `parentId` · [`ID!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/id.md) non-null scalar

#### `name` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

Display name

#### `ancestors` · [`[SupCategory!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-category.md) non-null object

List of all ancestor in category tree.

#### `children` · [`[SupCategory!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-category.md) non-null object

List of direct children in category tree.

#### `path` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

Slash separated path. Can be used to visit URL for category page. (e.g. `/electronic-parts/circuit-protection/esd-and-circuit-protection-ics`)

#### `relevantAttributes` · [`[SupAttribute!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-attribute.md) non-null object

List of Attributes deemed to be relevant to this category. (e.g. Resistance for Resistor category). Useful for showing contextual filters in UI.

#### `blurb` · [`SupBlurb`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-blurb.md) object

Blurb for Category, used on /electronic-parts pages.

#### `numParts` · [`Int!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) non-null scalar

Number of parts in Category.

# SupCompany

A company record represents a manufacturer or distributor, depending on context.

### Common Data Model

- [Company](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/Company) — Supply Company represents an organization in the electronics supply chain. Depending on context it is the manufacturer of a Part or a distributor (or broker) that sells it.

  - IRI: [`https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/Company`](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/Company)
  - GRID: `grid:supply::platform:company/{id}`

### Returned By

[`supManufacturers`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-manufacturers.md) query · [`supSellers`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-sellers.md) query

### Member Of

[`SupCompanyBucket`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-company-bucket.md) object · [`SupEvalKit`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/types/objects/sup-eval-kit.md) object · [`SupPart`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part.md) object · [`SupPartFamily`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family.md) object · [`SupPartGroup`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-group.md) object · [`SupPartSeller`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part-seller.md) object · [`SupRefDesign`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/types/objects/sup-ref-design.md) object · [`SupRefPublisherBucket`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/types/objects/sup-ref-publisher-bucket.md) object · [`SupSoftwareProject`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/types/objects/sup-software-project.md) object · [`SupSolutionTemplate`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/objects/sup-solution-template.md) object · [`SupSolutionTemplateRefDesignPublisherBucket`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/objects/sup-solution-template-ref-design-publisher-bucket.md) object

```graphql
type SupCompany {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  aliases: [String!]!
  displayFlag: String
  homepageUrl: String
  slug: String!
  isVerified: Boolean!
  isBroker: Boolean! @deprecated
  isDistributorApi: Boolean!
  isOctocartSupported: Boolean!
  isSuspended: Boolean!
  customPricingDetails: SupCustomPricingDetails
}
```

### Fields

#### `id` · [`ID!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/id.md) non-null scalar

Octopart internal id

#### `name` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

Display name of company

#### `aliases` · [`[String!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

Aliases of company

#### `displayFlag` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

The country code for the display flag

#### `homepageUrl` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

Homepage URL of company

#### `slug` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

Used for URLs like `/manufacturers/aimtec` or `/distributors/digi-key`

#### `isVerified` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) non-null scalar

True if a manufacturer participates in Octopart's Verified Manufacturer program. See [verified](https://octopart.com/verified) for more information.

#### `isDistributorApi` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) non-null scalar

True if a distributor has an API integration with Octopart to provide latest pricing and stock data.

#### `isOctocartSupported` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) non-null scalar

True if Octocart is supported for this distributor

#### `isSuspended` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) non-null scalar

True if the company is temporarily suspended and excluded from normal results.

#### `customPricingDetails` · [`SupCustomPricingDetails`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-custom-pricing-details.md) object

Custom Pricing details.

#### Deprecated

#### `isBroker` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) **DEPRECATED** non-null scalar

> **Deprecated:** use `PartSeller.is_broker` instead

True if a distributor is a broker. See [authorized](https://octopart.com/authorized) for more information.

# SupOffer

An offer is a specific buyable part from a distributor, with specific packaging, pricing, stock, moq.

### Common Data Model

- [Offer](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/Offer) — Supply Offer represents a specific commercial listing of a Part from a supplier, detailing price breaks, stock availability, lead times, and ordering conditions at a given point in time.

  - IRI: [`https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/Offer`](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/Offer)
  - GRID: `grid:supply::platform:part/{id}/offer/{offerID}`

### Member Of

[`SupPartSeller`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part-seller.md) object

```graphql
type SupOffer {
  _cacheId: String!
  id: ID!
  sku: String!
  eligibleRegion: String
  inventoryLevel: Int!
  packaging: String
  moq: Int
  prices: [SupPricePoint!]!
  clickUrl: String!
  updated: DateTime!
  factoryLeadDays: Int
  onOrderQuantity: Int
  factoryPackQuantity: Int
  orderMultiple: Int
  multipackQuantity: Int
  isCustomPricing: Boolean!
}
```

### Fields

#### `_cacheId` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

Cache ID

#### `id` · [`ID!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/id.md) non-null scalar

Octopart internal ID for this offer

#### `sku` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

Stock Keeping Unit used by internally by distributor

#### `eligibleRegion` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

The code indicating the region(s) for which offer is valid

#### `inventoryLevel` · [`Int!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) non-null scalar

Number of units available to be shipped. (aka Stock, Quantity)

#### `packaging` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

Packaging of parts (eg Tape, Reel)

#### `moq` · [`Int`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) scalar

Minimum Order Quantity: smallest number of parts that can be purchased

#### `prices` · [`[SupPricePoint!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-price-point.md) non-null object

The price points of the offer, sorted by minimum order quantity

#### `clickUrl` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

The URL to view offer on distributor website. This will redirect via Octopart's server.

#### `updated` · [`DateTime!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/date-time.md) non-null scalar

The last time data was received from distributor feed or API for this offer.

#### `factoryLeadDays` · [`Int`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) scalar

Number of days to acquire parts from factory.

Requires plan feature: `LEAD_TIME`.

#### `onOrderQuantity` · [`Int`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) scalar

Number of parts on order from factory.

#### `factoryPackQuantity` · [`Int`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) scalar

Order multiple for factory orders.

#### `orderMultiple` · [`Int`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) scalar

Number of items which must be ordered together.

#### `multipackQuantity` · [`Int`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) scalar

The quantity of parts as packaged by the seller.

#### `isCustomPricing` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) non-null scalar

Whether this offer is specific to the customer making the request.

# SupPart

Part model contains the relevant data around a part, including: datasheets, specs, sellers + offers, images, etc.

### Common Data Model

- [Part](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/Part) — Supply Part represents a market-available instance of a manufactured Part, providing aggregated sourcing data such as pricing, stock levels, and supplier offers.

  - IRI: [`https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/Part`](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/Part)
  - GRID: `grid:supply::platform:part/{id}`

### Returned By

[`supParts`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-parts.md) query

### Member Of

[`DatBomPart`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/procurement/types/objects/dat-bom-part.md) object · [`SupEvalKit`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/types/objects/sup-eval-kit.md) object · [`SupPart`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part.md) object · [`SupPartFamilyPart`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family-part.md) object · [`SupPartGroup`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-group.md) object · [`SupPartMatch`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part-match.md) object · [`SupPartResult`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part-result.md) object · [`SupRefEvaluationKit`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/types/objects/sup-ref-evaluation-kit.md) object · [`SupRefPart`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/types/objects/sup-ref-part.md) object · [`SupSponsoredPart`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-sponsored-part.md) object

```graphql
type SupPart {
  _cacheId: String!
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  mpn: String!
  genericMpn: String!
  manufacturer: SupCompany!
  manufacturerUrl: String
  freeSampleUrl: String
  documentCollections: [SupDocumentCollection!]!
  shortDescription: String!

  images: [SupImage!]!
  specs: [SupSpec!]!
  slug: String!
  octopartUrl: String!
  similarParts: [SupPart!]!
  companionProducts: [SupSponsoredPart!]!
  category: SupCategory
  series: SupPartSeries
  bestImage: SupImage
  bestDatasheet: SupDocument
  referenceDesigns: [SupReferenceDesign!]!
  cad: SupPartCad
  cadRequestUrl: String
  v3uid: ID!
  counts: Map!
  medianPrice1000: SupPricePoint
  totalAvail: Int!
  avgAvail: Float!
  sellers(
    includeBrokers: Boolean! = false
    authorizedOnly: Boolean! = false
    customPricingOnly: Boolean! = false
  ): [SupPartSeller!]!
  estimatedFactoryLeadDays: Int
  akaMpns: [String!]!
  extras: SupPartExtras
}
```

### Fields

#### `_cacheId` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

Cache ID

#### `id` · [`ID!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/id.md) non-null scalar

Octopart internal ID for this part. Appears at the end of PDP URL / `slug` field.

#### `name` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

manufacturer + mpn for easy display

#### `mpn` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

Manufacturer Part Number

#### `genericMpn` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

Best guess at a generic MPN

#### `manufacturer` · [`SupCompany!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-company.md) non-null object

Company that manufactures this part

#### `manufacturerUrl` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

A link to the manufacturer detail page for this part or series.

#### `freeSampleUrl` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

A link to a manufacturer page to request free sample kits for this part.

#### `documentCollections` · [`[SupDocumentCollection!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-document-collection.md) non-null object

Documents including Datasheets, Compliance Documents, PCNs

Requires plan tier: `PRO`. Requires plan feature: `DATASHEETS`.

#### `shortDescription` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

Best description around 110 characters long, as can be seen on SERP or PDP. May need truncation if all descriptions are long.

#### `descriptions` · [`[SupDescription!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-description.md) non-null object

All part descriptions from sources

#### `images` · [`[SupImage!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-image.md) non-null object

All part images

#### `specs` · [`[SupSpec!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-spec.md) non-null object

Attribute values for this part

Requires plan tier: `PRO`. Requires plan feature: `TECH_SPECS`.

#### `slug` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

Path component of PDP URL (e.g. `/ad7792bruz-analog+devices-402798`)

#### `octopartUrl` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

A link to the part page on Octopart. Do not include `rel="nofollow"` when linking to this URL.

#### `similarParts` · [`[SupPart!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part.md) non-null object

Parts identified by Octopart to be similar in specs and functionality.

Requires plan tier: `ENTERPRISE`.

#### `companionProducts` · [`[SupSponsoredPart!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-sponsored-part.md) non-null object

Parts identified by the manufacturer as companion products.

Requires plan tier: `ENTERPRISE`.

#### `category` · [`SupCategory`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-category.md) object

#### `series` · [`SupPartSeries`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part-series.md) object

#### `bestImage` · [`SupImage`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-image.md) object

#### `bestDatasheet` · [`SupDocument`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-document.md) object

Requires plan tier: `PRO`. Requires plan feature: `DATASHEETS`.

#### `referenceDesigns` · [`[SupReferenceDesign!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-reference-design.md) non-null object

Requires plan tier: `PRO`. Requires plan feature: `DATASHEETS`.

#### `cad` · [`SupPartCad`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part-cad.md) object

Data about part's CAD model. If null `cadRequestUrl` can be used to request a CAD model be made.

#### `cadRequestUrl` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

URL to request a CAD model from eeconcierge if a part doesn't already have a CAD model. Will be null part is not eligible, e.g. a multimeter

#### `v3uid` · [`ID!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/id.md) non-null scalar

The UID from Octopart APIv3. Provided for backwards compatibility, in general ID should be used.

#### `counts` · [`Map!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/map.md) non-null scalar

A Map of number of related objects. Can be used to know the number of `images` or `descriptions` without having to request those related objects.

#### `medianPrice1000` · [`SupPricePoint`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-price-point.md) object

The median USD price at quantity 1,000, discarding outliers. A reasonable estimate of average price for a part.

#### `totalAvail` · [`Int!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) non-null scalar

Sum of stock available across all distributors

#### `avgAvail` · [`Float!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/float.md) non-null scalar

The average stock level at each distributor

#### `sellers` · [`[SupPartSeller!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part-seller.md) non-null object

Companies with Offers for this part

##### `includeBrokers` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) non-null scalar

##### `authorizedOnly` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) non-null scalar

##### `customPricingOnly` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) non-null scalar

#### `estimatedFactoryLeadDays` · [`Int`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) scalar

The estimated factory lead time in days derived from trusted distributor offers.

Requires plan tier: `PRO`. Requires plan feature: `LEAD_TIME`.

#### `akaMpns` · [`[String!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

This part might be known by these alternate MPNs

#### `extras` · [`SupPartExtras`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part-extras.md) object

Nexar supply part data for internal use only.

```graphql
}
```

# SupPartResultSet

Result of part search.

### Returned By

[`supSearch`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-search.md) query · [`supSearchMpn`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-search-mpn.md) query

```graphql
type SupPartResultSet {
  total: Int! @deprecated
  hits: Int!
  results: [SupPartResult!]
  specsViewAttributeGroups: [SupAttributeGroup!]!
  warnings: [String!]
  specAggs(
    attributeNames: [String!]!
    attributeSelection: SupSpecAggsSelection! = EXPLICIT
    size: Int! = 10
  ): [SupSpecAgg!]!
  manufacturerAgg(
    size: Int! = 10
  ): [SupCompanyBucket!]!
  distributorAgg(
    size: Int! = 10
  ): [SupCompanyBucket!]!
  categoryAgg(
    size: Int! = 10
  ): [SupCategoryBucket!]!
  childCategoryAgg(
    size: Int! = 10
  ): [SupCategoryBucket!]!
  cadAgg: [SupCadBucket!]!
  cadLevelAgg: [SupLevelBucket!]!
  suggestedCategories: [SupCategoryBucket!]!
  suggestedFilters: [SupAttribute!]!
  allFilters(
    sort: SupAllFiltersSort! = default
    minCoverage: Float! = 0.01
  ): [SupAttribute!]!
  appliedCategory: SupCategory
  appliedFilters: [SupAppliedFilter!]!
}
```

### Fields

#### `hits` · [`Int!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) non-null scalar

Number of parts in result set

#### `results` · [`[SupPartResult!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part-result.md) list object

Contains nested part along side some fields specific to the query that explain reason for match.

#### `specsViewAttributeGroups` · [`[SupAttributeGroup!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-attribute-group.md) non-null object

Grouped attributes used to render the columns in specs view.

Requires plan tier: `PRO`. Requires plan feature: `TECH_SPECS`.

#### `warnings` · [`[String!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) list scalar

If an invalid query was modified or rejected, warnings indicate this fact to the user. For example if query contained too many tokens, some tokens may be ignored.

#### `specAggs` · [`[SupSpecAgg!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-spec-agg.md) non-null object

Perform aggregations on Spec values across multiple Attributes. You \*must\* specify `attributeNames` for this field to be populated. `attributeNames` should be a list of Attribute.shortname values (e.g. `capacitance` or `voltageRatingDc`)

- You can set `attributeSelection=WITHSUGGESTED` to additionally include suggested attributes for aggregation
- Alternatively, set `attributeSelection=ALL` to include all attributes for aggregation
- To rely solely on suggested attributes, set `attributeSelection=WITHSUGGESTED` and `attributeNames=[]`

Requires plan tier: `PRO`. Requires plan feature: `TECH_SPECS`.

##### `attributeNames` · [`[String!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

a list of Attribute.shortname values to aggregate on (e.g. `capacitance` or `voltageRatingDc`)

##### `attributeSelection` · [`SupSpecAggsSelection!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/enums/sup-spec-aggs-selection.md) non-null enum

defines how attributes are selected for aggregation (default EXPLICIT)

##### `size` · [`Int!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) non-null scalar

number of spec value buckets to return (default 10, maximum 500). Larger values are clamped to 500 and reported in `warnings`.

#### `manufacturerAgg` · [`[SupCompanyBucket!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-company-bucket.md) non-null object

Aggregate on manufacturers for this result set

##### `size` · [`Int!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) non-null scalar

number of buckets to return (default 10, maximum 500). Larger values are clamped to 500 and reported in `warnings`.

#### `distributorAgg` · [`[SupCompanyBucket!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-company-bucket.md) non-null object

Aggregate on distributors for this result set

##### `size` · [`Int!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) non-null scalar

number of buckets to return (default 10, maximum 500). Larger values are clamped to 500 and reported in `warnings`.

#### `categoryAgg` · [`[SupCategoryBucket!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-category-bucket.md) non-null object

Aggregate on categories for this result set

number of buckets to return (default 10, maximum 500). Larger values are clamped to 500 and reported in `warnings`.

#### `childCategoryAgg` · [`[SupCategoryBucket!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-category-bucket.md) non-null object

Aggregate on child categories for this result set. Will be empty if appliedCategory is null.

##### `size` · [`Int!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) non-null scalar

number of buckets to return (default 10, maximum 500). Larger values are clamped to 500 and reported in `warnings`.

#### `cadAgg` · [`[SupCadBucket!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-cad-bucket.md) non-null object

#### `suggestedCategories` · [`[SupCategoryBucket!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-category-bucket.md) non-null object

Categories that are determined by search algo to be related to the search term. Useful for suggesting a Category filter in the search UI.

Attributes that are determined by search algo to be related to the search term. Useful for suggesting most relevant filters in the search UI.

#### `allFilters` · [`[SupAttribute!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-attribute.md) non-null object

Full list of available Attributes in the result set

# SupPartSeller

A company with offers for a given part

### Member Of

[`SupPart`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part.md) object

```graphql
type SupPartSeller {
  _cacheId: String!
  company: SupCompany!
  country: String
  offers: [SupOffer!]!
  isAuthorized: Boolean!
  isBroker: Boolean!
  isRfq: Boolean!
  shipsToCountries: [SupCountry!]!
}
```

### Fields

#### `_cacheId` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

Cache ID

#### `company` · [`SupCompany!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-company.md) non-null object

The distributor

#### `country` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

Distributor's country

#### `offers` · [`[SupOffer!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-offer.md) non-null object

List of offers. Multiple offers may exist in different packaging. While multiple geo-targeted offers may exist, currently the API only exposes one geo-targeted offer at a time based on `country` parameter. Please contact us if you have a need to see all geo-targeted offer variants.

#### `isAuthorized` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) non-null scalar

True if the distributor is an authorized distributor for this manufacturer. See [authorized](https://octopart.com/authorized) for more information.

#### `isBroker` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) non-null scalar

True if the distributor is a Non-Authorized Dealer. See [authorized](https://octopart.com/authorized) for more information.

#### `isRfq` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) non-null scalar

True if you can request a quote from this seller.

#### `shipsToCountries` · [`[SupCountry!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-country.md) non-null object

List of countries the seller ships to. An empty list represents zero shipping restrictions.

# SupPartSeries

See [series](https://octopart.com/series) page for examples.

```graphql
  url: String!
```

#### `url` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

# SupPricePoint

Price in a specific currency + quantity. By supplying a `currency` parameter the API will populate an estimated convertedPrice in the user's desired currency.

### Member Of

[`SupOffer`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-offer.md) object · [`SupPart`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part.md) object

```graphql
type SupPricePoint {
  _cacheId: String!
  quantity: Int!
  price: Float!
  currency: String!
  convertedPrice: Float!
  convertedCurrency: String!
  conversionRate: Float!
}
```

### Fields

#### `_cacheId` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

Cache ID

#### `quantity` · [`Int!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) non-null scalar

Minimum purchase quantity to get this price (aka price break)

#### `price` · [`Float!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/float.md) non-null scalar

Price in currency

#### `currency` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

Currency for price

#### `convertedPrice` · [`Float!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/float.md) non-null scalar

Price converted to user's currency using foreign exchange rates.

Since this is an estimate, an indicator should be shown to user if currency != convertedCurrency.

#### `convertedCurrency` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

Currency for `convertedPrice`. Will match value of `currency` argument.

#### `conversionRate` · [`Float!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/float.md) non-null scalar

The exchange rate used to calculate convertedPrice

# SupSearchCorrection

### Returned By

[`supSearchCorrection`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-search-correction.md) query

```graphql
type SupSearchCorrection {
  correctionType: SupCorrectionType!
  correctionString: String!
  droppedTerms: [String!]!
  droppedFilters: SupDroppedFilter!
  hits: Int!
}
```

### Fields

#### `correctionType` · [`SupCorrectionType!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/enums/sup-correction-type.md) non-null enum

The type of suggestion this is. Useful for knowing how the suggestion was generated

#### `correctionString` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

The new search string for this suggestion

#### `droppedTerms` · [`[String!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

List of any terms from the original search string that have been dropped in this correction. Only populated in `DROPPEDTERM` type corrections

#### `droppedFilters` · [`SupDroppedFilter!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-dropped-filter.md) non-null object

List of any filters from the original search that have been dropped in this correction. Only populated in `DROPPEDFILTER` type corrections

#### `hits` · [`Int!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) non-null scalar

Estimated number of part hits for this correction

# SupSuggestion

Suggests a query based on partial query input. Used for autocomplete / typeahead UIs.

### Returned By

[`supSuggest`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-suggest.md) query

```graphql
type SupSuggestion {
  text: String!
  inCategoryName: String!
  inCategoryId: String!
  inManufacturerName: String!
  inPartId: String!
}
```

### Fields

#### `text` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

Suggested text of longer query

#### `inCategoryName` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

If the suggestion should also apply a categoryId filter, this is the category name

#### `inCategoryId` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

If the suggestion should also apply a categoryId filter, this is the Category ID

#### `inManufacturerName` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

If the suggestion should also apply a manufacturer filter, this is the Manufacturer name

#### `inPartId` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

If the suggestion should also apply a partId filter, this is the Part ID

# SupPartMatchOptions

### Member Of

[`supMultiMatch`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-multi-match.md) query

```graphql
input SupPartMatchOptions {
  requireAuthorizedSellers: Boolean
  requireStockAvailable: Boolean
  filters: Map
}
```

### Fields

#### `requireAuthorizedSellers` · [`Boolean`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) scalar

If true, only parts with at least one authorized seller will be returned.

#### `requireStockAvailable` · [`Boolean`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) scalar

If true, only parts with stock available will be returned.

#### `filters` · [`Map`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/map.md) scalar

a key: value map of filters. See [filter values](https://octopart.com/api/v4/values#attributes)

# Part Family

Part families and part groups, their parameters, and search across families and their parts.

For AI assistants: [llms.txt](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/llms.txt) · [schema slice](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/schema.graphql) · [all types](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types.txt)

## Entities

API types in this bounded context that represent Common Data Model (CDM) entities. The IRI is the entity's stable identifier in the CDM.

| API type | CDM entity |
| - | - |
| [`SupPartFamily`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family.md) | [Part Family](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/PartFamily) [`https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/PartFamily`](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/PartFamily) |
| [`SupPartGroup`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-group.md) | [Part Group](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/PartGroup) [`https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/PartGroup`](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/PartGroup) |

# supPartFamilyPartSearch

Search for part and group them by Part Group if applicable.

### Type

#### [`SupPartFamilyPartResultSet`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family-part-result-set.md) object

[`SupPartFamilyPartResultSet`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family-part-result-set.md) is the search results with pagination information.

```graphql
supPartFamilyPartSearch(
  q: String
  mpn: String
  inStockOnly: Boolean
  hasDatasheetOnly: Boolean
  filters: Map
  start: Int! = 0
  limit: Int! = 20
): SupPartFamilyPartResultSet!
```

### Arguments

#### `q` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

The query text for descriptive search.

#### `mpn` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

The query text for MPN matching search. Override q when this input is given.

#### `inStockOnly` · [`Boolean`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) scalar

Filter to remove parts with no stocking distributors.

#### `hasDatasheetOnly` · [`Boolean`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) scalar

Filter to only include parts with a datasheet.

#### `filters` · [`Map`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/map.md) scalar

Spec Filters to be applied.

#### `start` · [`Int!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) non-null scalar

Start offset of the results in the result set.

#### `limit` · [`Int!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) non-null scalar

Limit of the number of results to return in the result set.

# supPartFamilySearch

Search for part families and groups. There is a limit on the number of parts allowed for each group. If you want the complete set of parts for a group make a follow up request to [`supPartGroupByName`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/operations/queries/sup-part-group-by-name.md) or [`supPartGroupById`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/operations/queries/sup-part-group-by-id.md).

### Type

#### [`SupPartFamilyResultSet`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family-result-set.md) object

[`SupPartFamilyResultSet`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family-result-set.md) is the search results with pagination and aggregation information.

```graphql
supPartFamilySearch(
  q: String!
  filters: SupPartFamilyFilterInput
  start: Int = 0
  limit: Int = 10
): SupPartFamilyResultSet!
```

### Arguments

#### `q` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

The query text for the descriptive search of the part groups.

#### `filters` · [`SupPartFamilyFilterInput`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/inputs/sup-part-family-filter-input.md) input

Part group filters to be applied to this search.

#### `start` · [`Int`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) scalar

Start offset of the results in the result set.

#### `limit` · [`Int`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) scalar

Page size of the results in the result set.

# SupPartFamily

`SupPartFamily` contains the relevant information related to a part family. It exists in a hierarchy of other part families, they can contain children which represent other part families or `partGroups` which represent the leaves of the hierarchy tree.

### Common Data Model

- [Part Family](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/PartFamily) — A manufacturer's grouping of parts in the supply data, where the kind of family is vendor-specific (e.g. Series or Family). Part families form a hierarchy: a family has either child families or, at the lowest level, Part Groups. Families sharing the same parent are usually close alternatives to one another.

  - IRI: [`https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/PartFamily`](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/PartFamily)
  - GRID: `grid:supply::platform:part-family/{id}`

### Member Of

[`SupPartFamily`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family.md) object · [`SupPartFamilyBucket`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family-bucket.md) object · [`SupPartGroup`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-group.md) object

### Interfaces

#### [`SupPartFamilyEntity`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/interfaces/sup-part-family-entity.md) interface

Shared Fields between `SupPartFamily` and [`SupPartGroup`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-group.md).

### Implemented By

[`SupPartFamilySearchResult`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/unions/sup-part-family-search-result.md) union

```graphql
type SupPartFamily implements SupPartFamilyEntity {
  id: ID!
  stableName: String!
  familyType: String!
  parent: SupPartFamily
  children: [SupPartFamily!]!
  partGroups: [SupPartGroup!]!
  siblings: [SupPartFamily!]!
  title: String!
  subtitle: String!
  overview: String!
  categoryID: String!
  applicationIDs: [String!]!
  tags: [SupPartFamilyTag!]!
  keyFeatures: [SupPartFamilyKeyFeature!]!
  manufacturerID: String!
  category: SupCategory!
  applications: [SupCategory!]
  manufacturer: [SupCompany!]
}
```

### Fields

#### `id` · [`ID!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/id.md) non-null scalar

`id` is the global resource id (GRID) for this Part Family.

#### `stableName` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

`stableName` is an immutable name of this part family.

#### `familyType` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

`familyType` describes the part family in a part family hierarchy. It is vendor and part family specific. Examples include: 'Series', 'Family', etc.

#### `parent` · [`SupPartFamily`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family.md) object

`parent` is the the direct parent of this family. This will be `null` if this is the highest level.

#### `children` · [`[SupPartFamily!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family.md) non-null object

`children` is a list of the part families that are the direct children of this family. There will be one of either `children` or `partGroups`.

#### `partGroups` · [`[SupPartGroup!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-group.md) non-null object

`partGroups` is a list of the part groups that are the direct children of this family. There will be one of either `children` or `partGroups`.

#### `siblings` · [`[SupPartFamily!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family.md) non-null object

`siblings` is a list of direct sibling part families of the current group, which have the same parent. They are usually a close alternative choice of the current group.

#### `title` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

`title` of the part family.

#### `subtitle` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

`subtitle` of the part family.

#### `overview` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

`overview` of the part family.

#### `categoryID` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

`categoryID` is the identifier of the part category of this part family.

#### `applicationIDs` · [`[String!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

`applicationIDs` is a list of the identifiers of relevant applications this part family can be useful for.

`keyFeatures` is the list of key part features relevant to this part family.

`manufacturerID` is the identifier of the manufacturer of this part family.

Aggregation of parameter values, `buckets` contains aggregations of the different parameter values. Will contain a `min`, `max`, and `units` if the parameter is a numeric value.

[`SupPartFamilyParameter`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family-parameter.md) object

```graphql
    size: Int = 10
  ): [SupPartFamilyParameterBucket!]!
  min: Float
  max: Float
  units: String
}
```

### Fields

Aggregation buckets for this parameter. 'size' specifies the number of aggregation buckets to include.

##### `size` · [`Int`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) scalar

#### `min` · [`Float`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/float.md) scalar

Min value of this parameter, if this is a numeric parameter.

#### `max` · [`Float`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/float.md) scalar

Max value of this parameter, if this is a numeric parameter.

#### `units` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

# SupPartFamilyParameterBucket

Aggregation bucket for parameter values. If the parameter is discrete it will be a terms aggregation. If the parameter is numeric it will be a range aggregation and `min`, `max` will be populated.

#### `title` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

#### `url` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

#### `thumbnailUrl` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

#### `updatedAt` · [`DateTime!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/date-time.md) non-null scalar
