# SupPartGroup

`SupPartGroup` contains the relevant information relating to a part group. It represents the leaves of the Part Family hierarchy, and contain the parts represented by this group.

### Common Data Model

- [Part Group](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/PartGroup) — A leaf of the part family hierarchy in the supply data, holding the parts that belong to it together with group-level information such as its manufacturer, overview, key features and documents. Groups sharing the same parent family are usually close alternatives to one another.

  - IRI: [`https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/PartGroup`](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/PartGroup)
  - GRID: `grid:supply::platform:part-group/{id}`

### Returned By

[`supPartGroupById`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/operations/queries/sup-part-group-by-id.md) query · [`supPartGroupByName`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/operations/queries/sup-part-group-by-name.md) query · [`supPartGroupByPartId`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/operations/queries/sup-part-group-by-part-id.md) query · [`supPartGroupsByIds`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/operations/queries/sup-part-groups-by-ids.md) query

### Member Of

[`SupPartFamily`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family.md) object · [`SupPartGroup`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-group.md) object

### Interfaces

#### [`SupPartFamilyEntity`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/interfaces/sup-part-family-entity.md) interface

Shared Fields between [`SupPartFamily`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family.md) and `SupPartGroup`.

### Implemented By

[`SupPartFamilyPartSearchResult`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/unions/sup-part-family-part-search-result.md) union · [`SupPartFamilySearchResult`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/unions/sup-part-family-search-result.md) union

```graphql
type SupPartGroup implements SupPartFamilyEntity {
  id: ID!
  stableName: String!
  parent: SupPartFamily
  siblings: [SupPartGroup!]!
  title: String!
  subtitle: String!
  overview: String!
  categoryID: String!
  applicationIDs: [String!]!
  tags: [SupPartFamilyTag!]!
  lifecycleStatus: SupPartFamilyLifecycleStatus!
  keyFeatures: [SupPartFamilyKeyFeature!]!
  manufacturerID: String!
  partIDs(
    start: Int! = 0
    limit: Int! = 10
  ): [String!]!
  price(
    country: String! = US
    currency: String! = USD
    quantity: Int! = 1000
  ): SupPartFamilyPrice
  complementaryParts: [SupPartFamilyComplementaryPart!]!
  referenceDesignIDs: [String!]!
  documents(
    type: SupPartFamilyDocumentType
  ): [SupPartFamilyDocument!]!
  softwareSupport: [SupPartFamilySoftwareSupport!]!
  videos: [SupPartFamilyVideo!]!
  category: SupCategory!
  applications: [SupCategory]!
  manufacturer: [SupCompany!]
  parts: [SupPart]!
}
```

### Fields

#### `id` · [`ID!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/id.md) non-null scalar

`id` is the global resource id (GRID) for this Part Group.

#### `stableName` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

`stableName` is an immutable name of this part family.

#### `parent` · [`SupPartFamily`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family.md) object

`parent` is the the part family representing the direct parent of this group.

#### `siblings` · [`[SupPartGroup!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-group.md) non-null object

`siblings` is a list of direct sibling part groups of the current group, which have the same parent. They are usually a close alternative choice of the current group.

#### `title` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

`title` of the part group.

#### `subtitle` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

`subtitle` of the part group.

#### `overview` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

`overview` of the key details of this part group.

#### `categoryID` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

`categoryID` is the identifier of the part category of this part group.

#### `applicationIDs` · [`[String!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

`applicationIDs` is a list of the identifiers of relevant applications this part group can be useful for.

#### `tags` · [`[SupPartFamilyTag!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family-tag.md) non-null object

`tags` is a list of additional metadata for categorizing this part group.

#### `lifecycleStatus` · [`SupPartFamilyLifecycleStatus!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/enums/sup-part-family-lifecycle-status.md) non-null enum

`lifecycleStatus` is an enum representing the normalized lifecycle status of this part group.

#### `keyFeatures` · [`[SupPartFamilyKeyFeature!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family-key-feature.md) non-null object

`keyFeatures` is the list of key part features relevant to this part group.

#### `manufacturerID` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

`manufacturerID` is the identifier of the manufacturer of this part group.

#### `partIDs` · [`[String!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

`partIDs` is the list of identifiers of the physical parts within this group. start and limit are used for paging part results (including those under the parts field). limit has a max value of 20, any value greater than this will be reduced to it.

##### `start` · [`Int!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) non-null scalar

##### `limit` · [`Int!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) non-null scalar

#### `price` · [`SupPartFamilyPrice`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family-price.md) object

`price` contains pricing information for this part group. It contains the minimum, maximum, and median unit price @ given quantity among all parts in the group.

##### `country` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

##### `currency` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

#### `complementaryParts` · [`[SupPartFamilyComplementaryPart!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family-complementary-part.md) non-null object

`complementaryParts` is a list of the identifiers of relevant parts which work with this group.

#### `referenceDesignIDs` · [`[String!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

`referenceDesignIDs` is a list of the identifiers of reference designs relevant to this part group.

#### `documents` · [`[SupPartFamilyDocument!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family-document.md) non-null object

`documents` is a list of the key documentation related to this part group.

[`SupPartFamily`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/types/objects/sup-part-family.md) contains the relevant information related to a part family. It exists in a hierarchy of other part families, they can contain children which represent other part families or `partGroups` which represent the leaves of the hierarchy tree.

# SupPartFamilyFilterType

Valid types for a parameter filter. These describe how this parameter can be used in filtering. `VALUES` indicates the parameter can be filtered based on a provided set of terms. `RANGE` indicates the parameter can be filtered based on a range of values, provided a min and max value.

### Member Of

```graphql
  RANGE
```

# supRefDesigns

Search a reference designs.

### Type

#### [`SupRefDesignResultSet`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/types/objects/sup-ref-design-result-set.md) object

Reference designs with pagination, aggregation information.

```graphql
supRefDesigns(
  q: String!
  filter: SupRefDesignFilterInput
  order: [SupRefDesignOrderInput!]
  start: Int! = 0
  limit: Int! = 10
): SupRefDesignResultSet!
```

### Arguments

#### `q` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

The search query string. Leave empty to query all.

#### `filter` · [`SupRefDesignFilterInput`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/types/inputs/sup-ref-design-filter-input.md) input

Optional structured filter input for searching.

#### `order` · [`[SupRefDesignOrderInput!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/types/inputs/sup-ref-design-order-input.md) list input

Sort order for results. Supports multiple fields.

# SupRefDesign

A reference design model aggregates the relevant documents, files and parts.

### Common Data Model

- [Reference Design](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/ReferenceDesign) — An example design published in the supply catalog, bringing together its design files (e.g. schematics and layouts), documentation and the parts it uses. In Renesas 365 a reference design can be imported into a solution, which adds it to the Workspace as a PCB project linked to that solution.

  - IRI: [`https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/ReferenceDesign`](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/ReferenceDesign)
  - GRID: `grid:supply::platform:ref-design/{id}`

### Returned By

[`supRefDesignById`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/operations/queries/sup-ref-design-by-id.md) query · [`supRefDesignByIds`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/deprecated/reference-design/operations/queries/sup-ref-design-by-ids.md) query · [`supRefDesignByName`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/operations/queries/sup-ref-design-by-name.md) query · [`supRefDesignsByIds`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/operations/queries/sup-ref-designs-by-ids.md) query

### Member Of

[`SupEvalKit`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/types/objects/sup-eval-kit.md) object · [`SupEvalKitDevice`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/types/objects/sup-eval-kit-device.md) object · [`SupRefDesign`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/types/objects/sup-ref-design.md) object · [`SupRefDesignResultSet`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/types/objects/sup-ref-design-result-set.md) object · [`SupSolutionTemplate`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/objects/sup-solution-template.md) object

### Implemented By

[`SupSolutionTemplateRefDesign`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/unions/sup-solution-template-ref-design.md) union

```graphql
type SupRefDesign {
  id: ID!
  title: String!
  stableName: String!
  subtitle: String
  description: String!
  type: SupRefDesignType!
  sourceUrl: String
  isVerified: Boolean!
  createdAt: DateTime!
  updatedAt: DateTime!
  hasEvalBoard: Boolean!
  publisherId: String!
  bomId: String
  releaseDate: DateTime
  defaultSchematicFile: String
  status: SupRefDesignStatus
  parts(
    designators: [String!]
    type: SupRefPartType
    types: [SupRefPartType]
    start: Int! = 0
    limit: Int! = 50
  ): [SupRefPart]!
  applicationIds: [String!]!
  evaluationKitIds: [String!]! @deprecated
  previewImages: [SupImage]
  faqs: [SupRefFaq!]!
  keyFeatures: [SupRefKeyFeature]!
  designFiles(
    type: String
    extensions: [String!]
  ): [SupRefDesignFile]!
  documentations: [SupDocument]!
  tags: [SupRefTag]
  softwares: [SupRefResource]!
  evaluationKits: [SupRefEvaluationKit!]
  publisher: [SupCompany!]
  applications: [SupCategory!]
  evalKitDetails(
    where: SupEvalKitByRefDesignFilterInput
    first: Int
    after: String
    last: Int
    before: String
  ): SupEvalKitConnection
  self: SupRefDesign
}
```

# SupRefDesignStatus

### Member Of

[`SupRefDesign`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/types/objects/sup-ref-design.md) object · [`SupRefDesignFilterInput`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/types/inputs/sup-ref-design-filter-input.md) input

```graphql
enum SupRefDesignStatus {
  DRAFT
  SUBMITTED
  ON_HOLD
  REVIEWING
  REJECTED
  ACTIVE
  INACTIVE
}
```

### Values

#### `DRAFT`

Work in progress, not yet submitted for review.

#### `SUBMITTED`

Design data has been submitted and awaits review.

#### `ON_HOLD`

Review or progress is paused pending further action.

#### `REVIEWING`

The design is currently under review.

#### `REJECTED`

The design was reviewed and rejected.

#### `ACTIVE`

The design is approved and published and it has active status.

#### `INACTIVE`

The design is not active.

# SupRefDesignType

### Member Of

[`SupRefDesign`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/types/objects/sup-ref-design.md) object · [`SupRefDesignFilterInput`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/types/inputs/sup-ref-design-filter-input.md) input · [`SupRefDesignTypeBucket`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/types/objects/sup-ref-design-type-bucket.md) object

```graphql
enum SupRefDesignType {
  DEMONSTRATION
  EVALUATION
  DEVELOPMENT
  STARTER
  REFERENCE_DESIGN
  EXPANSION
  SYSTEM
  EXAMPLE
}
```

### Values

#### `DEMONSTRATION`

Highlights a component feature, often for marketing or sales purposes.

#### `EVALUATION`

Intended to test specific electrical/mechanical characteristics.

#### `DEVELOPMENT`

Enables code/hardware development and prototyping.

#### `STARTER`

Bundled offering to help users ramp up quickly.

#### `REFERENCE_DESIGN`

Complete application or subsystem design with documentation.

#### `EXPANSION`

Extends capabilities of a dev board. Often optional.

#### `SYSTEM`

Combines multiple board types, sensors, or modules into a full system.

#### `EXAMPLE`

Example project demonstrating specific use cases or implementations.

# Solution Template

Solution templates, reusable blueprints for an integrated hardware and software solution, and their applications, parameters, compatible evaluation kits and reference designs.

For AI assistants: [llms.txt](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/llms.txt) · [schema slice](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/schema.graphql) · [all types](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types.txt)

## Entities

API types in this bounded context that represent Common Data Model (CDM) entities. The IRI is the entity's stable identifier in the CDM.

| API type | CDM entity |
| - | - |
| [`SupSolutionTemplate`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/objects/sup-solution-template.md) | [Solution Template](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/SolutionTemplate) [`https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/SolutionTemplate`](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/SolutionTemplate) |

## Entry points

Look up entities by identifier:

- [`supSolutionTemplateApplicationById`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/operations/queries/sup-solution-template-application-by-id.md)
- [`supSolutionTemplateById`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/operations/queries/sup-solution-template-by-id.md)
- [`supSolutionTemplatesByIds`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/operations/queries/sup-solution-templates-by-ids.md)

# supSolutionTemplateApplications

List a solution template applications.

### Type

#### [`SupSolutionTemplateApplication`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/objects/sup-solution-template-application.md) object

```graphql
supSolutionTemplateApplications(
  q: String
  start: Int! = 0
  limit: Int! = 10
): [SupSolutionTemplateApplication]!
```

### Arguments

#### `q` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

The search query string. Leave empty to query all.

#### `start` · [`Int!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) non-null scalar

Offset in the result set.

#### `last` · [`Int`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) scalar

#### `before` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

# SupSolutionTemplate

### Common Data Model

- [Solution Template](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/SolutionTemplate) — A publisher's template for a solution, held in the supply catalog. It brings together catalog software projects, evaluation kits and a system design (ESD) source, and users can clone it.

  - IRI: [`https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/SolutionTemplate`](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/SolutionTemplate)
  - GRID: `grid:supply::platform:solution-template/{id}`

### Returned By

[`supSolutionTemplateById`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/operations/queries/sup-solution-template-by-id.md) query · [`supSolutionTemplateByName`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/operations/queries/sup-solution-template-by-name.md) query · [`supSolutionTemplates`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/operations/queries/sup-solution-templates.md) query · [`supSolutionTemplatesByApplicationId`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/operations/queries/sup-solution-templates-by-application-id.md) query · [`supSolutionTemplatesByIds`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/operations/queries/sup-solution-templates-by-ids.md) query

### Member Of

[`SupSolutionTemplate`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/objects/sup-solution-template.md) object · [`SupSolutionTemplateConnection`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/objects/sup-solution-template-connection.md) object · [`SupSolutionTemplateEdge`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/objects/sup-solution-template-edge.md) object

### Implemented By

[`SupSolutionTemplateRefDesign`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/unions/sup-solution-template-ref-design.md) union

```graphql
type SupSolutionTemplate {
  id: ID!
  title: String!
  stableName: String!
  publisherId: String!
  status: SupSolutionTemplateStatus!
  description: String
  sourceUrl: String
  solutionSourceUrl: String @deprecated
  createdAt: DateTime!
  updatedAt: DateTime!
  updatedById: String
  updatedByName: String
  evalKitIds: [ID!]! @deprecated
  evalKits: [SupEvalKit!]!
  esdSource: SupSolutionTemplateESDSource!
  previewImages: [SupImage!]
  bestPreviewImage: SupImage
  applicationIds: [String!]!
  parameters: [SupSolutionTemplateParameterBundle!]!
  compatibleEvalKits: [SupSolutionTemplateCompatibleEvalKit!]!
  refDesignIds: [String!]! @deprecated
  refDesigns: [SupRefDesign!]!
  aiModelIds: [String!]
  tags: [SupSolutionTemplateTag]
  keyFeatureGroups: [SupSolutionTemplateKeyFeatureGroup!]!
  requirementTemplate: String
  releaseDate: DateTime
  softwareProjectIds: [ID!]! @deprecated
  softwareProjects: [SupSoftwareProject!]!
  applications: [SupCategory!]
  publisher: [SupCompany!]
  self: SupSolutionTemplate
}
```

```graphql
  nodes: [SupSolutionTemplateApplication!]
  totalCount: Int!
}
```

# SupSolutionTemplateConnection

A connection to a list of items.

### Returned By

[`supSolutionTemplateSearch`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/operations/queries/sup-solution-template-search.md) query

```graphql
type SupSolutionTemplateConnection {
  pageInfo: PageInfo!
  edges: [SupSolutionTemplateEdge!]
  nodes: [SupSolutionTemplate!]
  totalCount: Int!
}
```

### Fields

#### `pageInfo` · [`PageInfo!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/objects/page-info.md) non-null object

Information to aid in pagination.

#### `edges` · [`[SupSolutionTemplateEdge!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/objects/sup-solution-template-edge.md) list object

A list of edges.

#### `nodes` · [`[SupSolutionTemplate!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/objects/sup-solution-template.md) list object

A flattened list of the nodes.

#### `totalCount` · [`Int!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/int.md) non-null scalar

Identifies the total count of items in the connection.

```graphql
    size: Int = 10

}
```

#### `value` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

The tag value.

#### `category` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

The tag category name.

# SupSolutionTemplateCompatibleEvalKitUpdateInput

Input for updating an existing compatible eval kit on a solution template.

### Member Of

[`SupSolutionTemplatePatchCompatibleEvalKitsInput`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/inputs/sup-solution-template-patch-compatible-eval-kits-input.md) input

```graphql
  compatibleEvalKitId: String!
  evalKitId: ID
  addParameters: [SupSolutionTemplateParameterBundleInput!]
  updateParameters: [SupSolutionTemplateParameterBundleInput!]
  removeParameterTitles: [String!]
}
```

### Fields

#### `compatibleEvalKitId` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

The identifier of the existing compatible eval kit to update.

#### `evalKitId` · [`ID`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/id.md) scalar

The new evaluation kit identifier, if changing which eval kit this row points to.

#### `addParameters` · [`[SupSolutionTemplateParameterBundleInput!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/inputs/sup-solution-template-parameter-bundle-input.md) list input

Parameters to add to this compatible eval kit. Fails if a title already exists on it.

#### `updateParameters` · [`[SupSolutionTemplateParameterBundleInput!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/inputs/sup-solution-template-parameter-bundle-input.md) list input

Parameters to update on this compatible eval kit. Fails if a title does not already exist on it.

#### `removeParameterTitles` · [`[String!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) list scalar

Parameter titles to remove from this compatible eval kit.

# SupSolutionTemplateCreateSolutionTemplateInput

Input for solution template creation.

### Member Of

[`supSolutionTemplateCreateSolutionTemplate`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-create-solution-template.md) mutation

```graphql
input SupSolutionTemplateCreateSolutionTemplateInput {
  title: String!
  stableName: String!
  publisherId: String!
  description: String
  sourceUrl: String
  solutionSourceUrl: String @deprecated
  requirementTemplate: String
  releaseDate: DateTime
  esdSource: SupSolutionTemplateEsdSourceInput!
  applicationIds: [String!]
  softwareProjectIds: [ID!] @deprecated
  previewImages: [SupSolutionTemplateFileInput!]!
  parameters: [SupSolutionTemplateParameterBundleInput!]
  compatibleEvalKits: [SupSolutionTemplateCompatibleEvalKitInput!]
}
```

### Fields

#### `title` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

The solution template title.

#### `stableName` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

The solution template stable name identifier.

#### `publisherId` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

The publisher identifier.

#### `description` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

The solution template description.

#### `sourceUrl` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

The source URL where the solution template is published.

#### `requirementTemplate` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

The default requirement string used when a user first clones the solution template.

#### `releaseDate` · [`DateTime`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/date-time.md) scalar

The optional release date of the solution template.

#### `esdSource` · [`SupSolutionTemplateEsdSourceInput!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/inputs/sup-solution-template-esd-source-input.md) non-null input

The ESD source.

#### `applicationIds` · [`[String!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) list scalar

The list of application identifiers associated with the solution template.

#### `previewImages` · [`[SupSolutionTemplateFileInput!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/inputs/sup-solution-template-file-input.md) non-null input

The list of solution template images input. The first image will be the best preview image.

#### `parameters` · [`[SupSolutionTemplateParameterBundleInput!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/inputs/sup-solution-template-parameter-bundle-input.md) list input

The list of parameters associated with the solution template application.

#### `compatibleEvalKits` · [`[SupSolutionTemplateCompatibleEvalKitInput!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/inputs/sup-solution-template-compatible-eval-kit-input.md) list input

The list of evaluation kit associated with the solution template.

#### Deprecated

#### `solutionSourceUrl` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) **DEPRECATED** scalar

> **Deprecated:** Use 'sourceUrl' instead.

The source URL where the solution template is published.

#### `softwareProjectIds` · [`[ID!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/id.md) **DEPRECATED** list scalar

> **Deprecated:** Use the SoftwareProject service to manage software project associations.

The list of software project identifiers associated with the solution template.

```graphql
  solutionTemplateId: ID!

  clearPreviewImage: Boolean
}
```

#### `documentFile` · [`SupSolutionTemplateFileInput`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/inputs/sup-solution-template-file-input.md) input

The ESD document file to upload and replace, if specified. There is no way to clear the document file once set.

#### `compileModel` · [`SupSolutionTemplateFileInput`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/inputs/sup-solution-template-file-input.md) input

#### `clearCompileModel` · [`Boolean`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) scalar

Clear the existing ESD compile model file when true.

#### `clearPreviewImage` · [`Boolean`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) scalar

# SupSolutionTemplateFilterInput

Input for filtering solution templates by additional conditions.

### Member Of

[`supSolutionTemplates`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/operations/queries/sup-solution-templates.md) query

```graphql
input SupSolutionTemplateFilterInput {
  statuses: [SupSolutionTemplateStatus!]
  publisherIds: [String!]
  aiModelIds: [String!]
  hasAIModels: Boolean
  tags: [String!]
}
```

### Fields

#### `statuses` · [`[SupSolutionTemplateStatus!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/enums/sup-solution-template-status.md) list enum

Filter by a list of solution template statuses if specified.

#### `publisherIds` · [`[String!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) list scalar

Filter by a list of publisher (company) identifiers if specified.

#### `aiModelIds` · [`[String!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) list scalar

Filter by a list of AI model identifiers if specified.

#### `hasAIModels` · [`Boolean`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) scalar

Indicates whether the solution template has AI models; null applies no filtering.

#### `tags` · [`[String!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) list scalar

Filter by a list of tag values (case-insensitive) if specified; matches solution templates having any of the tags.

# SupSolutionTemplateSearchFilterInput

Represents the filter for searching solution templates.

```graphql
input SupSolutionTemplateSearchFilterInput {
  ids: [ID!]
  q: String
  title: String
  description: String
  stableNames: [String!]
  statuses: [SupSolutionTemplateStatus!]
  publisherIds: [String!]
  updatedByIds: [String!]
  aiModelIds: [String!]
  hasAIModels: Boolean
  tags: [String!]
}
```

### Fields

#### `ids` · [`[ID!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/id.md) list scalar

Searches by solution template identifiers.

#### `q` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

Searches by text data (title, stable name, description).

#### `title` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

Searches by solution template title.

#### `description` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

Searches by description.

#### `stableNames` · [`[String!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) list scalar

Searches by stable name identifier.

#### `statuses` · [`[SupSolutionTemplateStatus!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/enums/sup-solution-template-status.md) list enum

Searches by solution template status.

#### `publisherIds` · [`[String!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) list scalar

Searches by a list of publisher (company) identifiers if specified.

#### `updatedByIds` · [`[String!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) list scalar

Searches by a list of user identifiers who last modified the solution template.

#### `aiModelIds` · [`[String!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) list scalar

Searches by AI model identifiers.

#### `hasAIModels` · [`Boolean`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) scalar

Indicates whether the solution template has AI models; null applies no filtering.

#### `tags` · [`[String!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) list scalar

Searches by tag values (case-insensitive); matches solution templates having any of the specified tags.

Replace the current solution template preview images with these ones. The first image will be used as a best preview image.

#### `newParameters` · [`[SupSolutionTemplateParameterBundleInput!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/inputs/sup-solution-template-parameter-bundle-input.md) **DEPRECATED** list input

> **Deprecated:** Use the SupSolutionTemplateSetParameters/SupSolutionTemplatePatchParameters mutations instead.

Replace the current solution template parameters with these ones.

#### `newCompatibleEvalKits` · [`[SupSolutionTemplateCompatibleEvalKitInput!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/inputs/sup-solution-template-compatible-eval-kit-input.md) **DEPRECATED** list input

> **Deprecated:** Use the SupSolutionTemplateSetCompatibleEvalKits/SupSolutionTemplatePatchCompatibleEvalKits mutations instead.

Replace the current solution template compatible eval kits with these ones.

# SupSolutionTemplateRefDesignType

### Member Of

[`SupSolutionTemplateRefDesignTypeBucket`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/objects/sup-solution-template-ref-design-type-bucket.md) object

```graphql
enum SupSolutionTemplateRefDesignType {
  DEMONSTRATION
  EVALUATION
  DEVELOPMENT
  STARTER
  REFERENCE_DESIGN
  EXPANSION
  SYSTEM
  EXAMPLE
  SOLUTION_TEMPLATE
}
```

### Values

#### `DEMONSTRATION`

Highlights a component feature, often for marketing or sales purposes.

#### `EVALUATION`

Intended to test specific electrical/mechanical characteristics.

#### `DEVELOPMENT`

Enables code/hardware development and prototyping.

#### `STARTER`

Bundled offering to help users ramp up quickly.

#### `REFERENCE_DESIGN`

Complete application or subsystem design with documentation.

#### `EXPANSION`

Extends capabilities of a dev board. Often optional.

#### `SYSTEM`

Combines multiple board types, sensors, or modules into a full system.

#### `EXAMPLE`

Example project demonstrating specific use cases or implementations.

#### `SOLUTION_TEMPLATE`

Complete solution template with documentation.

```graphql
  DRAFT
  SUBMITTED
  ON_HOLD
  REVIEWING
  REJECTED
  ACTIVE
  INACTIVE
}
```

### Values

#### `DRAFT`

Work in progress, not yet submitted for review.

#### `SUBMITTED`

Solution Template data has been submitted and awaits review.

#### `ON_HOLD`

Review or progress is paused pending further action.

#### `REVIEWING`

The solution template is currently under review.

#### `REJECTED`

The solution template was reviewed and rejected.

#### `ACTIVE`

The solution template is approved and published and it has active status.

#### `INACTIVE`

The solution template is not active.

# Eval Kit

Evaluation kits, their devices, parameters, preview images, and the reference designs and software projects they are compatible with.

For AI assistants: [llms.txt](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/llms.txt) · [schema slice](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/schema.graphql) · [all types](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/types.txt)

## Entities

API types in this bounded context that represent Common Data Model (CDM) entities. The IRI is the entity's stable identifier in the CDM.

| API type | CDM entity |
| - | - |
| [`SupEvalKit`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/types/objects/sup-eval-kit.md) | [Evaluation Kit](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/EvalKit) [`https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/EvalKit`](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/EvalKit) |

# SupEvalKit

### Common Data Model

- [Evaluation Kit](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/EvalKit) — A vendor evaluation kit in the supply catalog, described by its associated devices, its reference designs (including a main one) and the software projects compatible with it. In Renesas 365 an eval kit can be linked to a solution, and the browser can connect to the kit over J-Link.

  - IRI: [`https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/EvalKit`](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/EvalKit)
  - GRID: `grid:supply::platform:eval-kit/{id}`

### Returned By

[`supEvalKitById`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/operations/queries/sup-eval-kit-by-id.md) query · [`supEvalKits`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/operations/queries/sup-eval-kits.md) query · [`supEvalKitsByIds`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/operations/queries/sup-eval-kits-by-ids.md) query

### Member Of

[`SupEvalKitConnection`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/types/objects/sup-eval-kit-connection.md) object · [`SupEvalKitEdge`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/types/objects/sup-eval-kit-edge.md) object · [`SupSoftwareProjectEvalKitSource`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/types/objects/sup-software-project-eval-kit-source.md) object · [`SupSolutionTemplate`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/objects/sup-solution-template.md) object · [`SupSolutionTemplateCompatibleEvalKit`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/objects/sup-solution-template-compatible-eval-kit.md) object

```graphql
type SupEvalKit {
  id: ID!
  title: String!
  publisherId: String!
  description: String
  sourceUrl: String
  createdAt: DateTime!
  updatedAt: DateTime!
  updatedById: String
  updatedByName: String
  previewImages: [SupImage!]
  bestPreviewImage: SupImage
  partIds: [String!]! @deprecated
  refDesignIds: [String!]! @deprecated
  refDesigns: [SupRefDesign!]!
  mainRefDesignId: String @deprecated
  mainRefDesign: SupRefDesign
  esdSource: SupEvalKitESDSource
  devices: [SupEvalKitDevice!]!
  parameters: [SupEvalKitParameter!]
  parts: [SupPart]!
  publisher: [SupCompany!]
  compatibleSoftwareProjectIds(
    start: Int! = 0
    limit: Int! = 100
  ): [ID!]! @deprecated
  compatibleSoftwareProjects(
    start: Int! = 0
    limit: Int! = 100
  ): [SupSoftwareProject!]! @deprecated
  compatibleSoftwareProjectData(
    where: SupEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectFilterInput
    first: Int
    after: String
    last: Int
    before: String
    order: [SupSoftwareProjectSortInput!]
  ): SupEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectConnection @deprecated
  compatibleSoftwareProjectDetails(
    where: SupEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectFilterInput
    first: Int
    after: String
    last: Int
    before: String
    order: [SupSoftwareProjectSortInput!]
  ): SupEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectConnection
}
```

# SupEvalKitCreateEvalKitInput

Input for evaluation kit creation.

### Member Of

[`supEvalKitCreateEvalKit`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/operations/mutations/sup-eval-kit-create-eval-kit.md) mutation

```graphql
input SupEvalKitCreateEvalKitInput {
  title: String!
  publisherId: String!
  description: String
  sourceUrl: String
  sourceFile: SupEvalKitFileInput
  refDesignIds: [ID!]
  previewImages: [SupEvalKitFileInput!]!
  partIds: [String!]
  compatibleSoftwareProjectIds: [ID!] @deprecated
}
```

### Fields

#### `title` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

The evaluation kit title.

#### `publisherId` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

The publisher identifier.

#### `description` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

The evaluation kit description.

#### `sourceUrl` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

The evaluation kit source url.

#### `sourceFile` · [`SupEvalKitFileInput`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/types/inputs/sup-eval-kit-file-input.md) input

The evaluation kit source file for building source url.

#### `refDesignIds` · [`[ID!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/id.md) list scalar

The list of Reference Design identifiers associated with the evaluation kit.

#### `previewImages` · [`[SupEvalKitFileInput!]!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/types/inputs/sup-eval-kit-file-input.md) non-null input

The list of evaluation kit images input. The first image will be the best preview image.

#### `partIds` · [`[String!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) list scalar

The list of Part identifiers associated with the evaluation kit.

#### Deprecated

#### `compatibleSoftwareProjectIds` · [`[ID!]`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/id.md) **DEPRECATED** list scalar

> **Deprecated:** CompatibleSoftwareProjectIds is deprecated and no longer accepted.

The list of Compatible Software Project identifiers associated with the evaluation kit.

# Supply Software Project

Software projects for solution templates, evaluation kits and reference designs, with their parameters and compatibility.

For AI assistants: [llms.txt](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/llms.txt) · [schema slice](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/schema.graphql) · [all types](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/types.txt)

The [`ID`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/id.md) scalar type represents a unique identifier, often used to refetch an object or as key for a cache. The ID type appears in a JSON response as a String; however, it is not intended to be human-readable. When expected as an input type, any string (such as `"4"`) or integer (such as `4`) input value will be accepted as an ID.

# SupSoftwareProject

### Common Data Model

- [Software Project](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/SoftwareProject) — A software project published in the supply catalog, together with the evaluation kits it is compatible with. In Renesas 365 it can be imported into a solution with a compatible eval kit; the import places the project in the Workspace and links it to the solution (see sft\_SoftwareProject).

  - IRI: [`https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/SoftwareProject`](https://w3id.org/altium/cdm/supply/SoftwareProject)
  - GRID: `grid:supply::platform:software-project/{id}`

### Returned By

[`supSoftwareProjectById`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-project-by-id.md) query · [`supSoftwareProjectEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectsByEvalKitId`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-project-eval-kit-compatible-software-projects-by-eval-kit-id.md) query · [`supSoftwareProjects`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-projects.md) query · [`supSoftwareProjectsByIds`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-projects-by-ids.md) query · [`supSoftwareProjectSolutionTemplateSoftwareProjectsBySolutionTemplateId`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-project-solution-template-software-projects-by-solution-template-id.md) query

### Member Of

[`SupEvalKit`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/types/objects/sup-eval-kit.md) object · [`SupEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectConnection`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/types/objects/sup-eval-kit-compatible-software-project-connection.md) object · [`SupEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectEdge`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/types/objects/sup-eval-kit-compatible-software-project-edge.md) object · [`SupSoftwareProjectConnection`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/types/objects/sup-software-project-connection.md) object · [`SupSoftwareProjectEdge`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/types/objects/sup-software-project-edge.md) object · [`SupSoftwareProjectSolutionTemplateSoftwareProjectsResult`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/types/objects/sup-software-project-solution-template-software-projects-result.md) object · [`SupSolutionTemplate`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/objects/sup-solution-template.md) object

```graphql
type SupSoftwareProject {
  id: ID!
  title: String!
  publisherId: String!
  recommendScore: Int!
  isRecommended: Boolean!
  description: String
  type: SupSoftwareProjectType!
  createdAt: DateTime!
  updatedAt: DateTime!
  updatedById: String
  updatedByName: String
  previewImages: [SupImage!]
  bestPreviewImage: SupImage
  parameters: [SupSoftwareProjectParameter!]
  publisher: [SupCompany!]
  compatibleEvalKits: [SupSoftwareProjectEvalKitSource!]
  compatibleEvalKit(
    id: ID!
  ): SupSoftwareProjectEvalKitSource
  compatibleEvalKitData(
    where: SupSoftwareProjectCompatibleEvalKitFilterInput
    first: Int
    after: String
    last: Int
    before: String
    order: [SupSoftwareProjectCompatibleEvalKitSortInput!]
  ): SupSoftwareProjectEvalKitSourceConnection @deprecated
  compatibleEvalKitDetails(
    where: SupSoftwareProjectCompatibleEvalKitFilterInput
    first: Int
    after: String
    last: Int
    before: String
    order: [SupSoftwareProjectCompatibleEvalKitSortInput!]
  ): SupSoftwareProjectEvalKitSourceConnection
}
```

# include

Directs the executor to include this field or fragment only when the `if` argument is true.

```graphql
directive @include(
  if: Boolean!
) on 
  | FIELD
  | FRAGMENT_SPREAD
  | INLINE_FRAGMENT
```

### Arguments

#### `if` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) non-null scalar

Included when true.

# skip

Directs the executor to skip this field or fragment when the `if` argument is true.

```graphql
directive @skip(
  if: Boolean!
) on 
  | FIELD
  | FRAGMENT_SPREAD
  | INLINE_FRAGMENT
```

### Arguments

#### `if` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) non-null scalar

Skipped when true.

# PageInfo

Information about pagination in a connection.

### Member Of

[`SupEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectConnection`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/types/objects/sup-eval-kit-compatible-software-project-connection.md) object · [`SupEvalKitConnection`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/types/objects/sup-eval-kit-connection.md) object · [`SupEvalKitSoftwareProjectToolchainConnection`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/types/objects/sup-eval-kit-software-project-toolchain-connection.md) object · [`SupSoftwareProjectConnection`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/types/objects/sup-software-project-connection.md) object · [`SupSoftwareProjectEvalKitSourceConnection`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/types/objects/sup-software-project-eval-kit-source-connection.md) object · [`SupSolutionTemplateApplicationConnection`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/objects/sup-solution-template-application-connection.md) object · [`SupSolutionTemplateConnection`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/types/objects/sup-solution-template-connection.md) object

```graphql
type PageInfo {
  hasNextPage: Boolean!
  hasPreviousPage: Boolean!
  startCursor: String
  endCursor: String
}
```

### Fields

#### `hasNextPage` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) non-null scalar

Indicates whether more edges exist following the set defined by the clients arguments.

#### `hasPreviousPage` · [`Boolean!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/boolean.md) non-null scalar

Indicates whether more edges exist prior the set defined by the clients arguments.

#### `startCursor` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

When paginating backwards, the cursor to continue.

#### `endCursor` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

When paginating forwards, the cursor to continue.

# Float

The `Float` scalar type represents signed double-precision fractional values as specified by [IEEE 754](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IEEE_floating_point).

# ID

The `ID` scalar type represents a unique identifier, often used to refetch an object or as key for a cache. The ID type appears in a JSON response as a String; however, it is not intended to be human-readable. When expected as an input type, any string (such as `"4"`) or integer (such as `4`) input value will be accepted as an ID.

# Int

The `Int` scalar type represents non-fractional signed whole numeric values. Int can represent values between -(2^31) and 2^31 - 1.

# Long

The `Long` scalar type represents non-fractional signed whole 64-bit numeric values. Long can represent values between -(2^63) and 2^63 - 1.

# String

The `String` scalar type represents textual data, represented as UTF-8 character sequences. The String type is most often used by GraphQL to represent free-form human-readable text.

# deprecated

Marks an element of a GraphQL schema as no longer supported.

```graphql
directive @deprecated(
  reason: String = "No longer supported"
) on 
  | FIELD_DEFINITION
  | ARGUMENT_DEFINITION
  | INPUT_FIELD_DEFINITION
  | ENUM_VALUE
```

### Arguments

#### `reason` · [`String`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) scalar

Explains why this element was deprecated, usually also including a suggestion for how to access supported similar data. Formatted using the Markdown syntax, as specified by [CommonMark](https://commonmark.org/).

# oneOf

Indicates exactly one field must be supplied and this field must not be `null`.

```graphql
directive @oneOf on INPUT_OBJECT
```

# specifiedBy

Exposes a URL that specifies the behavior of this scalar.

```graphql
directive @specifiedBy(
  url: String!
) on SCALAR
```

### Arguments

#### `url` · [`String!`](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/types/scalars/string.md) non-null scalar

The URL that specifies the behavior of this scalar.
